subject.title: WhatsApp session stalls on long model_call: incomplete turn with payloads=0, reply never delivered

question: Should maintainers revive or replace the narrow WhatsApp final-error delivery fix now, or fold that slice into the broader durable final fallback contract while the Codex lane-release PR proceeds separately?
rationale: Current main still has the WhatsApp suppression path, the direct WhatsApp PR is closed unmerged, and the only open closing PR covers a different lane-release slice, so automation should not choose the remaining delivery-contract sequencing on its own.

options.title: Split The Two Fix Slices
options.body: Port or replace the WhatsApp final-error delivery fix separately while reviewing the Codex lane-release PR as the linked session-state slice.

options.title: Fold Into Contract Issue
options.body: Keep this issue open as a proving case and implement WhatsApp delivery together with the broader durable final fallback contract.

options.title: Wait For Live Proof
options.body: Hold further delivery work until a live WhatsApp long-turn fallback proof confirms the exact remaining failure after the lane-release PR is resolved.

recommendation.title: Split The Two Fix Slices
recommendation.body: Port or replace the WhatsApp final-error delivery fix separately while reviewing the Codex lane-release PR as the linked session-state slice.

likelyOwner.reason: osolmaz is assigned to this issue and owns the broader durable final fallback delivery contract issue that includes this case.
